governance: Section E: Zero-Shot Metric Authority Audit
aggregation_rule: Equal-weight unweighted mean across the 5 canonical tasks (task-level macro accuracy). Each task accuracy is the mean of binary item-level correctness (correct == true) across all items in that task.

statistical_tests.task_level: McNemar exact two-sided binomial test on 2x2 discordant contingency table
statistical_tests.macro_level: Stratified 10,000 paired bootstrap resampling within each task to obtain 95% confidence intervals and p-values
